user_query: What waitlist rank still gets a seat in CS 241, and when does the registrar freeze the roster?

retrieved_docs.text: Registrar note — CS 241: students through waitlist rank 8 are typically seated from no-shows. The roster freeze is 17 September at 17:00. Adds after freeze require a signed override from the instructor. Assistants cannot file overrides.
